description: This PHP class represents a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for handling employee skills within a reporting system. It extends a normalizable DTO and interacts with the Employee entity to extract skill-related information, providing methods for normalization and referencing employee skills based on employee number.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) for employee skills, enabling normalization and retrieval of skill data linked to employees based on employee number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Skill DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the skill data related to the employee into an array format based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of field names to getter methods for skill properties.
